label: PF Backlog 302
title: Scoped learnings (project/area) + memory read-back: need-based injection, not global broadcast
body:
Extend core/learnings.py to support scope filters (project/area) and a scoped store (products/

/learnings.json) with global fallback; add project=/area= to render() and pass them at the agent_runner injection site so approved items apply ON NEED, not to every project. Also add an opt-in bounded PRIOR RUN NOTES block from core.agent_memory.retrieve (memory is currently write-only). Static contract intact; bounded (chars/items).
